prompts.title: Digital Oil Painting
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the primary visual reference for facial structure, proportions, hairstyle, age, and overall appearance.

Preserve the same face shape, jawline, eye spacing, nose, lips, skin tone, expression, hair volume, curl pattern, and natural texture.

Keep the subject’s age, hairstyle, and identity consistent with the reference.

Do not beautify, reshape, or stylize the face.
Create a lush, evocative digital painting that blends Impressionist oil textures with a cinematic, moody atmosphere, capturing a quiet, reflective moment inside a café during a rainy city night.
Subject & Composition
A young woman with natural voluminous curly hair sits at a small bistro table, shown in side profile, gazing out through a large window.

Her chin rests on her hand, posture relaxed and still, expressing gentle nostalgia and introspection.
Use a frame-within-a-frame composition:

Warm café interior on the right
Cool, rain-soaked street on the left
Subject positioned on the right third of the frame
Outfit (Preserve Exactly)
Cream / off-white silk blouse
Soft sheen, slightly loose fit
Open V-neck collar
Long sleeves with natural fabric folds
Subtle warm highlights from the lamp reflecting on the silk texture
Table Details (Foreground)
On the round brass-rimmed table:

A vintage black-and-silver rangefinder camera
A small brass lamp with a pleated shade casting golden light
A slender glass vase with two white orchids
A white ceramic plate with a half-eaten cinnamon roll
Lighting & Color
Interior (Warm):

Ochre, honey gold, soft amber highlights on the blouse and face.
Exterior (Cool):

Deep blues, purples, and magenta reflections.

Rain-blurred lights and car headlights appear as glowing bokeh orbs.
Artistic Style
Thick impasto oil-paint brush strokes
Canvas grain texture
Soft cinematic glow
Lost-and-found edges: face sharp, background softly blended
High dynamic range, ultra-detailed, painterly realism
Gemini Negative Prompt
distorted face, identity change, different hairstyle, wrong age, different clothing, cartoon style, plastic skin, flat lighting, blur, extra limbs, low resolution, oversmoothing
prompts.description: Generate a stunning impressionist oil painting of a woman in a rainy city cafe with this high-quality AI prompt. This prompt creates cozy, cinematic scenes featuring thick brushstrokes, warm lamp lighting, and nostalgic details like a vintage camera, white orchids, and a cinnamon roll against a moody urban backdrop.

images.alt: Impressionist oil painting of a woman with curly hair in a rainy city cafe with a vintage camera and pastry.
